description.string: When an unknown user logs in, a new user entity is automatically created under that entity. If you do not want to automatically create new users, leave this field blank. Then only manually added users can log in.

Kui tundmatu kasutaja logib sisse, luuakse selle objekti alla automaatselt uus kasutaja. Kui te ei soovi automaatselt uusi kasutajaid luua, jätke see väli tühjaks. Siis saavad sisse logida ainult käsitsi lisatud kasutajad.

Defines a category of objects in your database (e.g. Project, Invoice, Person). Each entity type sets which fields its entities have, where they can be created, and who can see them. [Read more →](http://entu.ee/configuration/entity-types/)

Controls where entities of this type can be created. Reference a menu entity to show this type in the "New…" button, an entity type to allow adding as a child of any instance, or a specific entity to restrict to one location.

Without this, the type cannot be created through the UI.
Entity automatically added as an additional _parent when a new entity of this type is created. Useful for routing new records into a fixed folder.
Explanation of what this entity type represents. Shown on the edit view of entities of this type.
Display name shown in the UI.
Plural display name for this entity type (e.g. `Projects`, `Invoices`).
Internal identifier used in API queries. Use lowercase, no spaces by convention.
Plugin to run on entities of this type. [Read more →](http://entu.ee/configuration/plugins/)

Defines a navigation item in the sidebar. Entity types reference a menu via their `add_from` field to appear under that menu's "New…" button and in the navigation. [Read more →](http://entu.ee/configuration/menus/)
Groups menu items under a named section heading. Items with the same value are shown together.
Display name shown in the sidebar.
Sort order within the group. Lower numbers appear first.
Entu API päring. Näiteks "_type.string=person&sort=name.string"
Defines which entities this menu shows and highlights the menu item as active when the current page URL matches. [Read more →](http://entu.ee/api/query-reference/)

Defines custom behaviour or UI that can be attached to an entity type or a specific property. Plugins are referenced from the `plugin` field on entity types or property definitions. [Read more →](http://entu.ee/configuration/plugins/)
Display name shown as the tab label in the edit drawer (for UI plugins).
If enabled, opens the plugin URL in a new browser window instead of an iframe tab.
Plugin type — determines when it is triggered and what happens. [Read more →](http://entu.ee/configuration/plugins/#plugin-types)
For UI plugins — the URL loaded in the iframe tab. For webhook plugins — the URL that receives the POST request when an entity is saved or created.

Defines a single field on an entity type — its data type, label, display options, and behaviour. Each property definition becomes one field in the edit form of that entity type's entities. [Read more →](http://entu.ee/configuration/entity-types/#adding-property-definitions)
Number of decimal places. Use with `number` type.
Help text shown in an info popover next to the field label.
A server-side expression computed on every save; the result replaces the field's stored value. [Read more →](http://entu.ee/api/formulas/)
Groups related fields into a named section. The value is used as the section heading.
Display name shown above the field in the edit form and entity page.
Plural label shown when the field has multiple values (e.g. `Tags` instead of `Tag`).
Allows multiple values for this field.
Marks the field as required — shown with a red indicator when empty.
Enables markdown rendering. Use with `text` type.
Stores a separate value per language. A language selector appears next to each input.
Internal identifier used in API queries. Letters, digits, and underscores only. Must be unique within the entity type.
Sort order within the group. Lower numbers appear first.
Plugin for custom UI or behaviour at the field level. [Read more →](http://entu.ee/configuration/plugins/)
Visible on the entity page but not editable through the UI.
Entu API päring objektide leidmiseks, millele saab selles parameetris viidata. Näiteks "_type.string=person&sort=name.string"
Filters which entities are selectable. Use with `reference` type (e.g. `_type.string=person`).
Indexes values for full-text search. Choose carefully — indexing too many fields slows down search across the entire database.
Defines a fixed list of allowed values — renders a dropdown in the entity edit view. Add values here. Use with `string` type.
Includes this property as a column in the child list table view.
Data type — determines the UI input and how values are stored. [Read more →](http://entu.ee/overview/properties/#property-types)

Uniqueness of a property value:
- **db**: Unique across all objects in the database.
- **db+type**: Unique across all objects of the same type in the database.
- **parent**: Unique among all objects with the same parent.
- **parent+type**: Unique among all objects of the same type with the same parent.
Pre-filled value when creating a new entity. Supports relative date offsets (e.g. `+1d`, `-7d`). [Read more →](http://entu.ee/configuration/entity-types/#property-defaults)
Hides the field from the edit form; its value still appears on the entity page. Use for formula-driven or integration-managed fields.

1:1 container for an org's catalog + lending. Root of the librarian-scoped subtree.
Physical copy of an edition (was `inventory_copy` in v3).
First-class loan record. Replaces v3 inline `inventory_copy.assigned_to`.
Org's consent. Admin creates; user accepts → member created + invitation deleted.
Person's consent. Person creates; admin accepts → member created + application deleted.
Recurring pattern that materialises into events. Series defines defaults; events inherit + override.
Member's pre-event commitment. Lives under person so member can create natively.
